content.text: AMISY ararimbe!
Wakinyo ransyerano nggwanyine raijo AMISY Ai!
Inya, vatano wasatawandi watavondi Amisye Ai weap, wapo ararimbe no wapa anugane rai!
Inya, Israel, wasanayanambe weye Wepi Po wasanari;
Inya, vatano wana no Sion,
wasananibe weye wapa Akarijo Titi pije!
Wasarer indamu Apa tame rararimbe,
weapo itari raeyan muno airape
ranepat indamu AMISY ararimbe!
Weye AMISY anuga no irati Apa kawasae mai;
muno Wepi Po anasineko marova mai raunanto irati vatano manuga mpaaje mai.
Indati Apa vatano matawandi utavondi Aije nawamo umananibe
weye Po marova apinde to,
muno ukiny manayanambe no arono unaki.
Koveamo wenao ukangkamambe Amisye Ai rave manamoto manakoeve rai,
umba wo anaiyu nsansinao raijaro maneme rai.
Indamu wo marova rasakinavo susyo wanave Amisye Ai jewene mansai,
muno mangke raugaje irati susye kotaro wanave Ai jewene mansai.
Indamu wo poor besi raasaro awa akarijo titi mai,
muno waijo besi veano awa akarijo wo nuge raijanande maokaisy.
Maisyare omaisy, wo mangke raugaje susyo mine so mai,
mamaisyo Amisye Apa dapatimuge rai.
Omirati kovo manakoe Amisye Po raugaje Apa kawasae matawandi utavondi Ai mansai mijem.
AMISY ararimbe!

footnotes.text: Sion omamo munijo Yerusalem ama tamo wusyine mijem, muno veano vatano Israel mawain tavon.
itari ranigwano ‘‘kecapi’’ rai muno airape ranigwano ‘‘rebana’’ rai.
